rca_of_issue.root_cause: server.py file contains duplicate route definitions for PUT /api/events/{event_id} and DELETE /api/events/{event_id} that were likely added before the activity logging feature was implemented. These routes don't call log_activity() and use the wrong Pydantic model (EventCreate instead of EventUpdate)
reproduction_steps: 1. Login and update any event via PUT /api/events/{event_id}
3. No update log will be created for the event
rca_of_issue.mitigation: Remove lines 3029-3051 in server.py OR add log_activity() calls to these existing routes and change EventCreate to EventUpdate
